requests.reply: {"translations": ["Getting started with Memotto", "Memotto is a note-taking app that can consolidate text, tables, and images into one place.", "In this guide, we will explain with examples from Yamanishi from PR and Takanashi from Sales."]}
{"translations": ["A short note added to a page is called a 'Quick Note'.", "Yamanashi-san leaves meeting decisions as a Quick Note.", "Yamanashi-san uses Sticky Notes to mark important parts."]}
{"translations": ["You can add up to ten items per page."]}
{"translations": ["For teams", "Takanashi's sales team first created a Space.", "The place where everyone can see inside a Space is called 'Commons'."]}
{"translations": ["In the Commons, anyone can post notes.","Takanashi shares sales plans in the Commons every morning.","You can invite members to a Space via email."]}
{"translations": ["Invited people will receive a confirmation email."]}
{"translations": ["Once approved by the administrator, you can join immediately.", "Member permissions can also be changed per Space.", "Sync and Revisions"]}

{"translations": ["Notes are saved automatically and synced to all devices.", "You can edit offline, and it will sync as soon as you connect.", "You can revert to a previous state from the page history."]}
{"translations": ["Tsukimisato-san recovered the text she accidentally deleted."]}
{"translations": ["Tips for organization", "It is convenient to pin important pages.", "Pinned pages are listed at the top of the list."]}
{"translations": ["Notes in the plaza are easier to find if you add tags.","You can create tags freely ◆","Takanashi divides tags by project."]}
{"translations": ["The same tag can be used for a brief note as well."]}
{"translations": ["In search, you can search for both Spaces and Sticky notes at the same time.", "If you can't find it, please try broadening your search scope."]}

translations.10: The place where everyone can see inside a Space is called 'Commons'.

translations.12: Takanashi shares sales plans in the Commons every morning.

translations.15: Once approved by the administrator, you can join immediately.
translations.16: Member permissions can also be changed per Space.

translations.19: You can edit offline, and it will sync as soon as you connect.

translations.23: It is convenient to pin important pages.
translations.24: Pinned pages are listed at the top of the list.
translations.25: Notes in the plaza are easier to find if you add tags.
